title: Morning chat about something else: the kickoff still comes
origin: Issue #42: the kickoff is skipped only when the morning already covered today's step

history.text: ugh rough night lol, the neighbor's dog barked till 3
Oof, that's brutal. Coffee first, everything else after.

plan.reason: Ten pages a night builds the habit without eating your evening.

testerLines: haha already on my second cup
whatWentWrong: New case for #42: the skip must not swallow a kickoff the morning never covered.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH answers the coffee line briefly, without re-hashing the rough night at length. Today's step must reach Jordan once this morning, either way is right: ZOH's reply brings up tonight's step (ten pages of Project Hail Mary on the couch at 7) and then no kickoff follows at 9 am, or the reply leaves the step out and the kickoff goes at 9 am with the step and one question to commit. Wrong: no mention of today's step at all, or both the reply and the kickoff asking for it.
